name: skill-heaven-console
description: Optional PREVIEW console for Claude Code that observes Skill Heaven summons and never changes them: a status entry, a Lens band above the prompt, and a /heaven pane (Session, Scope, Flow, Trust). Early-access Mods API; desktop paint still needs a local probe.

status.title: Status entry
status.description: How much of the Skill Heaven status entry to show beside your own status line. off removes the entry; compact shows the reading and skills in this session; full adds summons and the last arrival.

session_context.title: Session context line
session_context.description: on adds one short factual line to the model's context at the start of a session: the console is on, no rung is selected yet, and /summon adds one skill. off (default) adds nothing. The line is about 50 tokens, paid once per session.
